proposal.hypothesis: Replacing three exact SSE2 divisions in the explicit kernel with a reciprocal estimate refined once by Newton iteration may reduce division latency while retaining near-single-precision results. The SIMD arithmetic and CND coefficients remain unchanged; unsafe denominators, exponential ranges, tails and unsupported builds use the scalar implementation. The controller must verify tolerance and measure it against the 7.529 ms ordinary-loop baseline and the 2.662 ms measured SSE2 parent; no speedup is assumed.

retained: Added an SSE2 helper that refines _mm_rcp_ps once and uses it for the vector log approximation, CND denominator and d1 denominator.
Added a positive-normal guard for v*sqrt(T), falling back to the scalar loop when the refined reciprocal denominator is unsafe.
Preserved the explicit four-option route, scalar fallbacks, tails, threading, compiler flags and all supplied Black-Scholes/CND coefficients.
